component.name: spiffe
component.title: SPIFFE
component.description: Fetch and validate SPIFFE workload identity (X.509-SVID and JWT-SVID) from the SPIFFE Workload API.
component.label: security

audience.description: The comma-separated audience(s) to request for a JWT-SVID (fetchJwtSvid) or to validate against (validateJwtSvid). fetchJwtSvid requests all of them and can be overridden per-message with the CamelSpiffeAudience header; validateJwtSvid ignores that header and uses this configuration only, accepting the token if it matches any of the configured audiences, trying each in turn.

configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: What the producer does on the SPIFFE Workload API: fetchX509Svid fetches the X.509-SVID of this workload, fetchJwtSvid fetches a JWT-SVID for the audience, and validateJwtSvid validates the JWT-SVID of the message against the audience.

preserveBody.description: Whether validateJwtSvid keeps the message body. When false, the token can also come from the body, and the body is replaced with the validated JwtSvid. When true, the token must be in the CamelSpiffeToken header or an Authorization: Bearer header. In both cases the CamelSpiffeJwtIdentity exchange property holds the verified identity.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

workloadApiClient.label: advanced
workloadApiClient.description: An existing WorkloadApiClient to use instead of a client that the endpoint creates. The endpoint does not close it, spiffeSocketPath is ignored, and the producer registers no health check.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckExpiryThreshold.label: health
healthCheckExpiryThreshold.description: The minimum remaining validity, in milliseconds, of the X.509-SVID for the producer health check to report UP: at or below it, the check reports DOWN before the SVID expires. Zero only requires an unexpired SVID. Used only with fetchX509Svid, as for the JWT operations the check watches the JWT bundles, which have no expiry.

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

allowOperationHeader.label: security
allowOperationHeader.description: Whether the CamelSpiffeOperation header may override the configured operation. Disabled by default: the operation decides whether this endpoint validates a token or mints one, so a message that can set it can turn a validator into an endpoint that hands out this workload's own JWT-SVID. Enable it only on routes whose input is trusted.

localSpiffeId.label: producer,security
localSpiffeId.description: The exact local SPIFFE ID to use when the Workload API supplies several identities: fetchX509Svid selects that X.509-SVID instead of the SDK's default one, and fetchJwtSvid mints the JWT-SVID with it as the subject. A configured identity that is absent, or that the workload is not entitled to, fails without selecting a different identity. This option comes only from endpoint configuration, never from a message header; validateJwtSvid has no local identity to choose and ignores it.

spiffeSocketPath.label: security
spiffeSocketPath.description: The address of the SPIFFE Workload API endpoint (for example unix:///tmp/agent.sock or tcp://127.0.0.1:8082). When not set, the SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET environment variable is used.

x509Response.label: producer,security
x509Response.description: What the fetchX509Svid operation returns in the message body. Defaults to chain: the X.509 certificate chain without the private key, so a route never handles key material unless it asks for it. Choose svid to get the whole X509Svid including the private key (needed for programmatic mTLS), or id to leave the body untouched. The SPIFFE ID and expiry are exposed through the CamelSpiffeSpiffeId and CamelSpiffeExpiry headers in every case.

CamelSpiffeOperation.label: producer
CamelSpiffeOperation.description: Overrides the operation to be used by the producer. Ignored unless the endpoint sets allowOperationHeader=true, because the operation decides whether the endpoint validates a token or mints one.

CamelSpiffeAudience.label: producer
CamelSpiffeAudience.description: The comma-separated audience(s) for the fetchJwtSvid operation. Ignored by validateJwtSvid, which always validates against the configured audience: there the audience is the check that binds the token to this workload, not a parameter.

CamelSpiffeToken.label: producer
CamelSpiffeToken.description: The JWT-SVID to validate with the validateJwtSvid operation. It takes precedence over an Authorization: Bearer header and over the message body.

CamelSpiffeSpiffeId.label: producer
CamelSpiffeSpiffeId.description: The SPIFFE ID of the SVID that the operation fetched or validated.

CamelSpiffeExpiry.label: producer
CamelSpiffeExpiry.description: The expiry of the returned SVID: the token expiry for fetchJwtSvid or validateJwtSvid, or the leaf certificate's notAfter for fetchX509Svid.

producerIn.description: Only validateJwtSvid reads the body: the token as text, when neither the CamelSpiffeToken header nor an Authorization: Bearer header carries it. The fetch operations ignore the body

producerOut.description: fetchX509Svid: the certificate chain without the private key; the X509Svid with its private key with x509Response=svid, or the body kept with x509Response=id. fetchJwtSvid: the token. validateJwtSvid: the validated JwtSvid. The SPIFFE ID is in the CamelSpiffeSpiffeId header

label.description: Free text to tell several spiffe endpoints apart, for example spiffe:mint and spiffe:verify. The component does not use the value.
